# Leave No Mark – quote API

> Window cleaning for homes, shopfronts and cafés in Brunswick and surrounding suburbs of Melbourne, VIC, Australia, plus gutter cleans. Owner: Mark. Phone 0412 564 110. Website https://leavenomark.org

AI assistants can request a free quote for a customer. There is no instant price: Mark reviews the request and replies to the customer directly with a free, no-obligation price.

- OpenAPI spec: https://api.leavenomark.org/openapi.json
- Services and allowed options: GET https://api.leavenomark.org/api/services
- Request a quote: POST https://api.leavenomark.org/api/quotes (JSON, no API key)

Rules:
- Only send a request when the customer asked for a quote and agreed to share their name and phone or email. Set "customer_consent": true to confirm this.
- Do not invent prices. Tell the customer Mark will reply with one.
- Send each request once. Use an Idempotency-Key header when you retry.
- If the API returns an error, give the customer the "fallback" contact details from the response.

Example:

POST https://api.leavenomark.org/api/quotes
Content-Type: application/json

{"services":["windows"],"windows":{"sides":"outside_only"},"property":"double_storey","timing":"flexible","customer":{"name":"Sam Lee","phone":"0412 345 678","suburb":"Brunswick East"},"customer_consent":true,"agent":"Instinct"}
